trail.text: Digging into the flagged spike — mapping the blast radius to find the root cause.
Many services show latency pain but route-service stands out — now checking its dependencies to isolate the source.
Route-service shows real resource pressure while its database looks healthy — now timing the failure to confirm the origin.
All signals spiked together at the flag — now checking downstream timing to confirm they're victims, not causes.

causes.reasoning: Memory working-set more than doubled 172M to 472M with system CPU 0.6 to 14 and p99 latency 0.024 to 0.86, while its mongo DB is flat, indicating internal pressure causing downstream latency.
Host disk writes exploded 25k to 863k mean with active memory surge, simultaneous with route-service memory spike, likely the host running that container reflecting the same incident.
p99 latency spiked 0.04 to 0.44 with flat CPU and memory, classic victim waiting on slow route dependency.
Latency spiked across percentiles but CPU and memory flat to down, indicating victim blocked on upstream rather than internal fault.
p99 latency jumped 0.028 to 0.41 with no memory or CPU increase, consistent with downstream propagation from route-service.
